## Summary

E160: GitHub devops repos view-count principle fresh observation. This is the 3rd fresh observation on GitHub repo topics: data-science and AI showed need-related Lower star counts, while devops shows need-related Higher mean star counts. Combined with E148/E149 general code repos showing Higher star counts, the principle's effect is now characterized as highly topic-dependent with varying direction and magnitude.
